item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 05:52 AM 20 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Biliran(Kawayan, Culaba, Caibiran, Biliran, Cabucgayan), #Palawan(Agutaya and Coron) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Biliran(Naval, Almeria), #Leyte(Calubian and SanIsidro) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
